deployment.accelerator: nvidiaTeslaT4; select GPU T4 x2 in the Kaggle runner. The upstream and private parents have isGpuEnabled=false in exported notebook metadata.
deployment.pool_version_and_usage: Open Pool V17 to V18. Preparation materializes filtered/sampled files; the live ensemble invocation passes neither --pool nor --extra.
deployment.guard: changed / all rows, before final style; maximum attainable fraction is floor(0.15*N)/N. Hence neither 0.25 nor 0.32 can trip under the submitted command. On excess the stage writes error_sanity and raises, rather than falling back.
deployment.fallback: Both production entries execute infer.py on every batch. Both use fallback_s10 only when the GLM budget covers fewer than 50 rows; the GLM stage writes normalized base logits and leaves prior predictions in place, then final style still runs. A real GLM subprocess failure propagates. Optional ensemble branches and their existing recoveries are inherited unchanged. This local test does not establish that every optional model will execute on Kaggle.

official_route: Queried real source and candidate v1_stage.main against cached true 160-token GLM/Flash features. Fitted the 54-feature head and style on other prompt folds; checked the public native member_logp against sklearn scores for every selected text. The cached Qwen8 bases proxy the complete deployed Qwen ensemble. Ablation changes only scale/guard, with identical selected rows and temperature per arm. The optional 76-feature corrected route is a separate local comparison and is absent from the notebook.
external_route: Sealed 54+216 passages, original two GPU GLM likelihood heads and Nishant dual Qwen with V30 fixed marginal projection. Stage.main consumed recorded GLM head log probabilities at its score-return boundary. The actual minimum of 50 prevents both GLM stages in these batch sizes. The additional 15% proxy relaxes only the minimum and uses the archived actual external likelihoods. 205/270 normalized external passages and all 270 prompt fingerprints occur in known full V30 training pools. No end-to-end hidden execution or team leaderboard result.
uncertainty: Official 4,000 paired draws over 150 prompt clusters. External 3,000 paired bootstrap draws stratified by observed class over unique prompts. Intervals cover the balanced-accuracy difference.
